distribution.title:
Data will be collected and generated to optimize MICP treatment for recycled aggregates, quantify its effects on concrete performance, and evaluate environmental impacts via LCA. This directly supports WP1 (develop and optimize MICP), WP2 (test rheology, mechanical, and durability properties of RAC with treated RA), and WP3 (perform LCA and assess scale-up feasibility).

The origin of the data will be the following:
1- Primary experimental data from RTU labs: MICP treatment logs, mix designs, fresh properties, mechanical and durability tests, and microstructure analyses (SEM, XRD), using RTU and partner facilities described in the proposal.
2- Recycled aggregates sourced from a local concrete recycling plant to reflect real-world variability.
3- Mobility-generated measurements at partner labs (Ghent University for MICP optimization, University of Tokyo for concrete testing, Lehigh University for LCA workflows).
4- LCA datasets derived from your measured energy, materials, and waste flows plus secondary database inputs documented in WP3.

dmp.description: This DMP defines how we will generate, document, store, secure, share, and preserve project data, and it keeps these decisions machine-actionable in Argos so we can link datasets, assign DOIs, and meet funder rules. It ensures compliance with Horizon Europe research data management and open science requirements. It applies the FAIR principles so others can find, access, interoperate with, and reuse our outputs. It specifies repositories, licenses, access levels, roles, and an update schedule across the project lifecycle.
